description: The bar chart illustrates the relative performance of three models, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), and an unnamed model represented by dark blue bars, across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the relative performance values, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2, although the axis label is not visible. Each category contains three bars: dark blue for the unnamed model, light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and grey for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), with the grey bars consistently having a value of 1.00. The dark blue bars have values ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.70, with the lowest value in PT-EVAL and the highest in KoBEST-CP, while the light blue bars have values between 0.46 and 0.74, with the lowest in PT-EVAL and the highest in KoBEST-CP. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order, and the grey bars are visually consistent across all categories, serving as a reference point.
